subtopics.title: Global Partnerships and Finance
subtopics.summary: The Riyadh Global Drought Resilience Partnership, launched at COP 16 in 2024, initially secured around USD 2.15 billion and aims to support 80 countries. The Business4Land Initiative is UNCCD's major platform for private sector involvement in sustainable land management, water management and land restoration. COP17 also promoted nature-based solutions and ecosystem restoration in national development planning.
facts: Riyadh Global Drought Resilience Partnership was launched during UNCCD COP 16 in Riyadh in 2024
The partnership initially secured around USD 2.15 billion in commitments
Its aim is to support 80 vulnerable and drought-affected countries through public and private finance
Business4Land Initiative is UNCCD's major platform for involving the private sector
Business4Land covers sustainable land management, water management and land restoration
COP17 promoted greater adoption of Nature-based Solutions
COP17 promoted Ecosystem-based Adaptation and Ecosystem Restoration in national development planning
Land degradation affects approximately 40% of the world's land surface
Land degradation threatens ecosystems, agriculture, water availability and economic stability

subtopics.title: India's Position and National Programmes
subtopics.summary: India launched a Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems at COP17 to improve their recognition and conservation. Under the Bonn Challenge, India has brought around 21.76 million hectares of degraded and deforested land under restoration, against a broader target of 26 million hectares by 2030. Domestic programmes include the National Action Plan to Combat Desertification, the Green India Mission, Mission Amrit Sarovar and the Aravalli Green Wall Initiative.
facts: India is a Party to the UNCCD
India launched the Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems (ONEs) at COP17
The guide seeks to improve recognition and conservation of ONEs such as the Thar Desert and Banni Grasslands
It also covers Deccan Savannas, Ravines and other open ecosystems
Under the Bonn Challenge, India has brought around 21.76 million hectares under restoration
This is part of India's broader target of restoring 26 million hectares by 2030
National Action Plan to Combat Desertification was introduced in 2001 and revised in 2023
Green India Mission is a component of the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC) and focuses on forest restoration and carbon sequestration
Mission Amrit Sarovar focuses on creation and rejuvenation of water bodies; Aravalli Green Wall Initiative restores degraded Aravalli areas
